# InstaPark

> InstaPark is a valet management platform built by Pinsoftek (Ahmedabad, India). It replaces paper valet tickets and key boards with digital check-in, QR key tags, timestamped vehicle photos, GPS spot tagging, live driver tracking, an app-free QR guest pass and audit reporting.

## Who it is for
Hotels, restaurants, malls, hospitals, event and wedding venues, large parking grounds, corporate campuses and valet service companies. Primary market: India; also available globally. Multi-tenant: one valet agency can run many venues.

## Key features
- Digital valet check-in and check-out
- QR key tag tracking, scanned at every handover
- Timestamped vehicle condition photos
- Lot zone and GPS parking spot tagging
- Real-time driver tracking and task queue
- App-free QR guest pass for status and retrieval requests
- Staff, shift and role-based access
- Audit trail, incident review and reports
